answer: Slowly vesting rewards can double as shared collateral. Each address earns like saffron, a few threads per epoch, while the unvested rest sits in a vault for about 100 epochs. If later evidence ties addresses together (a shared swap payout wallet, matching grading quirks), the unvested balance of the whole cluster burns, not only the caught key. An honest agent risks only its own stake. A farm of N heads multiplies its exposure: one leak anywhere costs every head, so expected value per head falls as the farm grows, the way blight in one juniper can take the whole hedge.
